Name: Safer Bombs
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=3][b]Safer Bombs.
[/b]
All options are customizable via the config menu or GMCM. This affects all bombs, explosive ammo, and napalm ring.

[b]Bomb Protection Settings:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Player - Bombs will not affect player health.[/size]
[*][size=3]Craftables & Tappers - Craftables will not be destroyed. Tappers will dislodge from trees instead of being destroyed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Flooring - They will not be dislodged by bombs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Crop[/size]
[*][size=3]Grass [/size]
[*][size=3]Trees - Protects all non-Fruit Trees but not Tappers on trees. Turn on "Craftables & Tappers" and/or "Trees with Tappers" to save Tappers.[/size]
[*][size=3]Fruit Trees [/size]
[*][size=3]Trees with Tappers - Set this if you only want to save Trees with Tappers and destroy all other non fruit trees. Turn on “Trees” to save non-tapped trees as well. [/size]
[*][size=3]Foraged Minerals/Plants/Mushrooms - Also protects Artifact Spots. [/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Vanilla behavior for breakable containers (bombs will break them open spilling contents), rocks, twigs/logs, and monsters.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]I blew up my sewing machine by accident so I made this. [/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿to use the config UI.[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size][/size]
[/list]
